title: Mega Man & Bass
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 2179 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Platformer. Life bar max assumed 28 (series standard). PC mGBA sweep (boot, mash, walk; C2 gbaverify): life 28 (full) -> 24 -> 18 -> 12 -> 6 as hits were taken (boss slots not checked). C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Mega Man (charge shot, slide) or Bass (rapid 8-way shot, double jump, dash).

widgets.text: Cold Man, Astro Man, Ground Man, Magic Man, Pirate Man, Burner Man, Tengu Man, Dynamo Man. Weakness chain: Lightning Bolt beats Cold Man, Ice Wall beats Burner Man...
